heading_path: VIII > A. Approval Limits > 2. Housing Loans
text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, NOT BANK POLICY. Housing loans are approved by the approving authority according to the loan amount. Loans with a policy deviation move up one approval tier.

heading_path: IX > G. Insurance > 6. Mortgage Redemption Insurance
text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, NOT BANK POLICY. Mortgage redemption insurance for a housing loan shall be taken on the principal borrower. If the principal borrower is not insurable, the co-borrower with the highest income is insured instead.

heading_path: VII > D. Credit Evaluation > 4. Exceptions > a. Debt Burden Ratio
text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, NOT BANK POLICY. Exception: a debt burden ratio above the limit may be considered when a qualified co-borrower with verified income is added. Requires approval one tier higher and a written mitigant.

heading_path: VII > D. Credit Evaluation > 4. Exceptions > b. Loan to Collateral Ratio
text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, NOT BANK POLICY. Exception: a loan to collateral ratio above 80% may be considered with higher borrower equity, additional collateral, or a higher interest rate. Requires committee approval.

heading_path: VII > D. Credit Evaluation > 4. Exceptions > c. Employment Tenure
text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, NOT BANK POLICY. Exception: employment tenure below two years is acceptable when the borrower changed jobs within the same industry and has a longer total work history.

heading_path: VII > D. Credit Evaluation > 4. Exceptions > d. Credit Score
text: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, NOT BANK POLICY. Exception: a credit score slightly below the acceptable cutoff may be considered for approval when stronger collateral and a larger down payment offset the risk.
SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE, NOT BANK POLICY. Demand letters are sent to delinquent housing loan borrowers at fixed intervals after the due date.
